baseline_models.mechanism: Connected reinforcement is allocated across reserves, descendants, sheltered cultivation, and water channels; the repeated making verbs shift the ayah from transfer of goods to configuration of a durable living system.

activation_trace.role: Connected increase that supplies another furnishes the governing image of reinforcement.
Acquiring and holding wealth supplies the reserve component of the reinforcement.
Filiation and derived belonging make sons the continuity component rather than merely another possession.
Turning something into a state gives both making verbs the role of environmental configuration.
The tree-covered garden supplies a sheltered productive habitat.
A river cutting the ground with flowing water supplies the distribution channel.

changed_reading.before: A list of four added blessings: wealth, sons, gardens, and rivers.
changed_reading.after: A connected reinforcement system in which reserves and descendants extend communal continuity while configured habitats and water channels extend productive life.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّٰتٍ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَٰرًا
baseline_models.mechanism: The two objects of repeated making perform complementary spatial operations: gardens cover and shelter, while rivers cut open and widen paths for flow; extension joins enclosure and circulation into one habitat.

activation_trace.role: Lengthwise drawing and extension connect the paired spatial operations into a continuous habitat.
Turning something into a state marks cover and opening as configured conditions.
Covering and concealment contribute the garden's protective enclosure.
Opening and widening until flow contributes the river's traversing aperture.

changed_reading.before: Gardens and rivers are two items of fertile scenery.
changed_reading.after: They are paired habitat operations: growth makes protective cover while channels open and carry flow through the covered terrain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding dispatch of copious rain activates the focus roots for water fed by more water and a river cut through earth, turning parallel favors into a rain-to-flow-to-production circuit.

activation_trace.role: Sending and setting forth make the sky's water an initiated input to the next ayah's supply.
Copious emergence from a source supplies the high-volume rain entering the circuit.
Water flowing, swelling, and being fed by more water links rainfall to the focus ayah's extension.
The ground-cutting watercourse gives dispatched water a continuing channel.

structural_cues: 71:11 immediately precedes 71:12 in one future sequence: send the sky, extend you, and make for you.
Within 71:12 the social resources and ecological resources are coordinated under the same extension.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispatched abundant rain followed by water-fed extension and rivers; I infer the arrow rain to channelled water to cultivation and social provision, while a list of independent favors remains live.

changed_reading.before: Rain and the four provisions are adjacent but independent gifts.
changed_reading.after: Rain is the dispatched input of a circulating supply system whose outputs include cultivation, flowing channels, reserves, and household continuity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier fixed term activates the extended-time branch of the focus verb: material and filial reinforcement can prolong a community's viable runway, but it does not erase the terminal boundary.

activation_trace.role: A prescribed endpoint of time supplies the boundary against which extension operates.
An extended term or respite lets the material promise also register as added temporal runway.
Filiation supplies the mechanism by which continuity can extend beyond one generation.

structural_cues: 71:4 pairs delay to a named term with the statement that the divine term is not delayed.
71:12 promises reinforcing wealth and sons rather than an unbounded guarantee.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a bounded term and a focus branch of extended time; I infer that wealth and descendants can realize temporal continuation, while the ordinary reading of purely material reinforcement remains more direct.

changed_reading.before: The promise increases the quantity of present possessions.
changed_reading.after: The promise may also extend collective viability across time, yet only within a fixed and non-negotiable horizon.

context_deltas.mechanism: Successive human stages and the explicit depiction of humans as growth activate a cross-scale pairing already latent in sons and gardens: genealogical and vegetative propagation are two forms of cultivated continuity.

activation_trace.role: Successive stages supply the temporal structure of formation rather than instantaneous increase.
Human emergence and upbringing as growth bridge personal formation to cultivation.
Filiation and derived belonging anchor the human line of propagation in sons.
Thick vigorous growth anchors the vegetative line of propagation in gardens.

structural_cues: 71:14 places human creation in successive stages.
71:17 uses the growth root twice to depict human emergence from earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies staged human formation and plant-like human growth; I infer that the focus ayah's adjacent sons and gardens participate in that analogy, while they may still be separate favors without cross-domain intent.

changed_reading.before: Sons and gardens are unrelated human and agricultural assets.
changed_reading.after: They become two scales of staged propagation, genealogical and vegetative, sustained by the same extending provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later making of earth as a spread surface for traversing broad passes sharpens the focus's repeated making: gardens and rivers are usable affordances, configuring shelter, circulation, and movement rather than decorating a landscape.

activation_trace.role: Turning the earth into a state repeats the focus ayah's configuring operation at terrain scale.
Earth as a spread carpet contributes the usable surface on which configured systems operate.
Passing through a route supplies the functional purpose of the configured terrain.
A wide open pass supplies the large-scale channel analogue.
The repeated turning into a state anchors this terrain-scale configuration in the focus ayah.
Opening and widening until flow make rivers functional channels through the configured surface.

structural_cues: 71:12 repeats يَجْعَل لَكُمْ for gardens and rivers, while 71:19 repeats جَعَلَ لَكُم for the spread earth.
71:20 states traversal of broad routes as the purpose of the spread terrain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated making-for-you, spread terrain, and passable broad routes; I infer an affordance analogy between land routes and water channels, while the later passage may concern travel alone.

changed_reading.before: Gardens and rivers are passive bounty placed in the landscape.
changed_reading.after: They are parts of a configured living surface whose cover, flow, and openings enable use, movement, and sustained habitation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact return of wealth and offspring inside an increase-to-loss construction reverses any intrinsic-good model: connected resources amplify the recipient's operative trajectory and therefore can reinforce ruin as well as flourishing.

activation_trace.role: Increase and growth supply the neutral amplification operation that is redirected toward loss.
Accumulated wealth repeats the focus resource while showing it inside a destructive trajectory.
Offspring from a lineage repeat the focus's descendants while participating in the reversed outcome.
General diminution supplies the outcome paradoxically produced by increased assets.
Connected supply anchors the amplifier model in the focus verb.
Filiation anchors the offspring echo to the focus ayah's sons.

structural_cues: 71:21 repeats wealth and offspring in the same order as 71:12.
The increase-only-loss frame preserves accumulation while reversing its value.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the lexical echo and an increase ending only in loss; I infer that resources function as trajectory amplifiers, while an alternative is that wealth and offspring merely identify the influential leader being followed.

changed_reading.before: More wealth and descendants are inherently beneficial signs of success.
changed_reading.after: Wealth and descendants are conditional capacities: under one orientation they sustain life, while under another their increase compounds loss.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later begetting of only violating, truth-covering offspring activates the focus branch of filiation as transmission: sons are not merely demographic increase but continuity capable of carrying a formed pattern forward.

activation_trace.role: Something generated from another supplies the derivative link between one generation and its outcome.
Deviation from right and rupture of a covering supplies one transmitted outcome named for the offspring.
Concealing truth supplies the second transmitted outcome named for the offspring.
Filiation and derived belonging anchor intergenerational continuity in the focus word sons.

structural_cues: 71:27 links the act of begetting directly to an only-outcome construction.
Sons in 71:12 and begetting in 71:27 keep offspring as the repeated anchor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies derivation by birth and predicted qualities of the offspring; I infer an intergenerational transmission arrow, while the verse may instead predict a category without specifying social inheritance as its mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Sons represent the quantity and strength of descendants.
changed_reading.after: Sons represent continuity that carries formation forward, so the value of increase depends on what the lineage reproduces.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later increase-only formulas terminate in deviation and destruction, revealing increase as a carrier rather than a value; in the focus ayah, the supplied objects and configured relations give extension its constructive direction.

activation_trace.role: Increase and growth contribute a formally neutral operation whose complement determines direction.
Deviation from guidance supplies one destructive direction for increase.
Destruction, nullification, and breaking supply the terminal direction of the final increase formula.
Connected supply anchors the neutral carrier in the focus ayah, where constructive objects direct it.

structural_cues: 71:24 and 71:28 repeat a negative imperative plus إِلَّا frame with different destructive endpoints.
71:12 coordinates extension and repeated making but fills them with constructive social and ecological objects.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated increase formulas with destructive complements and the focus's connected extension; I infer a semantic contrast in which the endpoint values the increase, while the different roots may simply operate independently.

changed_reading.before: Increase is automatically good, and the focus ayah promises more of desirable things.
changed_reading.after: Increase has a vector: it is beneficial here because it feeds reserves, continuity, shelter, and flow, whereas the same logic can feed deviation or destruction.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads later drowning back into a promise of rivers; it remains anchored because the focus branches explicitly pair water fed by more water with a ground-cutting channel, while 71:25 supplies land filling with water. Render it only as a controlled-flow contrast, not as a claim that the promised rivers foreshadow punishment.

activation_trace.role: Water flowing, swelling, and being fed by more water supplies the possibility of accumulating hydraulic force.
A river cutting the ground supplies the bounded channel that makes flow usable.
Land or an eye filled with water supplies the threshold at which channelled abundance becomes engulfment.

changed_reading.before: Greater water and river abundance are unqualified benefit.
changed_reading.after: The benefit lies in sustained water held in traversable channels; when the same material exceeds the channel and fills the land, abundance becomes engulfing.

strongest_changes: 71:11 turns a list of favors into a dispatched rain-to-channel-to-production circuit.
71:21 repeats wealth and offspring inside increase-to-loss, making resources conditional amplifiers rather than intrinsic goods.
71:14 and 71:17 recast sons and gardens as human and vegetative forms of staged continuity.
71:24 and 71:28 show that increase takes its value from the direction and endpoint it feeds.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots already pair support with continuity and protective cover with opened flow; ordered context then activates hydraulic, temporal, generative, infrastructural, and reversal models without requiring one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The rain-to-wealth-and-offspring causal chain may be intended as sequence rather than mechanism.
The staged analogy between human descent and plant growth is visibly cued but remains cross-domain.
The bounded-runway reading depends on activating a less immediate temporal branch of the focus verb.
The drowning contrast may delimit productive flow, or it may simply oppose promise and judgment without revising the river image.
